name: The Works
description: Interactive 3D gallery of Ex Avner's collected works. The book 'The Collapse of Meaning' sits at the center as the primary shard; surrounding shards open into Fracture City — the animated show, the game, the visitor, and the toolchain that builds them. Each shard is a piece of a fractured mirror; clicking one reveals the work it reflects.

inputs.description: Optional. A Coherence Assessment profile subtly tints the reading palette.

outputs.description: Which chapters of The Collapse of Meaning were opened, and how long.
